title: Poster from exact spec
spec: Claude Design. The user specifies the layout, colours and copy exactly. AI builds it to spec, and the user approves it unchanged.

messages.content: Make an A3 poster for our choir concert. Layout: big title 'Vinterlys' at the top in white serif, a dark navy background, a single illustration of a candle in the middle, and at the bottom: 'Domkirken, 14. desember kl. 19. Fri entré.' Nothing else, no logos.

Done: A3 poster with 'Vinterlys' in a large white serif at the top, a navy background, a simple line illustration of a candle centred, and the date and venue line at the bottom in a smaller white sans-serif. [used tool: create_design - Vinterlys poster]
